item.title: The X-ecutive Decision
item.description: Read The X-ecutive Decision He checked our security camera system and found several blind spots. He bought bright orange duct tape and made X marks on the floor with it in those blind spots. He told the sales teams that, if we were not actively assisting a customer, we should find an orange X to stand on. Read The X-ecutive Decision

item.title: You’re One Of Today’s Ten Thousand
item.description: Read You’re One Of Today’s Ten Thousand Customer: "Yeah, like you can see your own face." Me: "Well, just your nose, I think." Customer: "Your nose is on your face, dumb-a**. How can you see it?" Read You’re One Of Today’s Ten Thousand

item.title: An Uplifting Work Experience
item.description: Read An Uplifting Work Experience I work on repairs and maintenance at a busy resort hotel. I regularly have polish scratches out of elevator walls while they are actively in use. Every time I did this, I embraced my impromptu role as an elevator boy with remarks such as: Me: "You know, you'll be... floored with the results when we're done." Read An Uplifting Work Experience

item.title: A Splash Of Misunderstanding
item.description: Read A Splash Of Misunderstanding I'm giving the usual safety speech for my group on the White-Water Rapids Tour. Me: "Alright, everyone, expect a lot of turbulence. Keep your feet inside the raft, listen to commands, and—" A hand shoots up from the back. Tourist: "Will we get wet?" Read A Splash Of Misunderstanding
